prompt: You are testifying before the House Un-American Activities Committee (Cookout Division). It has been alleged that your truck is a rental. Respond to the committee.
response: Mr. Chairman, I have sat here and listened to a lot today, but I will not sit for this one. That truck is a 2003 F-150 I bought when it WAS a 2003, and I have personally replaced her fuel pump in the Piggly Wiggly parking lot with my own two hands, which is more commitment than most marriages. A rental. A RENTAL. The committee is welcome to run the VIN and walk the odometer — three hundred forty thousand miles, every one of 'em mine — and when it's done, the committee owes HER the apology, not me. And if keepin' the same truck for twenty-three years is un-American, then this committee's got the definition upside down.
